study type: Secondary analysis of a clinical trial using probabilistic modeling (Bayesian networks)
cohort: The study analyzed data from 118 women diagnosed with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) participating in the STEADY SUGAR clinical trial.
finding: Direct associations were identified between neonatal hypoglycemia and maternal hypertension, family history for diabetes, elevated maternal BMI, and cesarean delivery, with CGM-derived metrics also linked to multiple neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was found to influence neonatal hypoglycemia risk (OR: 2.05 [0.98, 4.28]).
